boundaries: Six historical formal FAILs, not new source measurements.
Only the five top-level intervals partition the original formal formula; nested ensure/create/read/start/register and claim credentials must not be added to parents.
Daemon preparation/startup use their own observed monotonic origin; do not align them to server UTC or sum them into server wall time.
E2B create is the observed server API interval; restore,boot,Node preload and worker-ready internal durations are not separately measured by this historical raw.
No new performance benchmark, SQL, model, resource, renderer or pins changes.
